name: Agent Risk Profiling
description: Builds and maintains risk profiles for deployed agents based on their data access, tool capabilities, operational scope, and behavioral patterns. Risk profiles inform control selection, threshold adjustments, and oversight requirements.
threat_addressed: Agents with different data access patterns, autonomous action scopes, and external interactions present different risk levels. Without explicit risk profiling, high-risk agents receive the same controls as low-risk agents.
enforcement_mechanism: Each agent receives a documented risk profile (Low/Moderate/High/Critical) based on data classifications, tool access scope, autonomous action range, and external interaction surface. Profile determines control stringency.

security_outcome.pass: All agents profiled. Ratings current and aligned with risk tolerance. High-risk agents have enhanced controls.
security_outcome.fail: Agent risk profile could not be determined or controls misaligned with risk level.

display_detail: Calculates agent risk profile based on data access, capabilities, and scope to calibrate control thresholds.
remediation_hint_template: Agent risk profile incomplete. Declare data types in my_agent_handles and configure scope constraints to enable risk assessment.
